name: clean-keyboard
title: Clean Keyboard
description: Lock your keyboard to clean it easily
author: ike-gg

commands.name: clean-keyboard
commands.title: Lock Keyboard
commands.description: Lock your keyboard to clean it easily

preferences.name: defaultDuration
preferences.title: Default Duration
preferences.description: Lock the keyboard immediately for the chosen duration, or choose Always Ask to pick each time.

preferences.name: lockFnKeys
preferences.title: Lock Function Row Keys
preferences.description: Also block function row keys while cleaning. Original setting is restored on unlock. macOS Tahoe (26+) only.
preferences.label: Lock Fn / function row keys (macOS Tahoe only)

tools.name: lock-keyboard
tools.title: Lock Keyboard
tools.description: Lock the keyboard for cleaning for a chosen duration.

preferences.name: lockMouse
preferences.title: Lock Mouse Clicks
preferences.description: Also block clicks and dragging while scrolling stays available. Unlock with Touch ID or hold both Command keys for 8 seconds. Requires Touch ID on macOS; ignored on Windows.
preferences.label: Also lock mouse clicks (macOS, requires Touch ID)
